title: PRESSER | Jonathan Maldonado - Postgame vs. Wofford (11-21-26)
text: What was working so well tonight for the defense? >> I think just going out there playing full speed, not really like worried about the opponent, whether it's you know FCS, FBS, don't care who it is, just going out there full speed and you know playing the same way we've been trying to play this entire season, you know not thinking about who's across the ball, just worrying about us, you know. >> Pete kind of sort of alluded like hey there there are reasons why the team could have checked out a little bit or not not been totally locked in today. Why why was the team so locked in? >> They were staying locked in really just to build our identity and find ourselves, you know it was a it was a it was a rough couple last games so just being able to you know go out there play full speed, make plays, it feels real good to all of us, you know no matter what the circumstances is, you know being able to do that really on any given Saturday man and we're at home, you know what I mean? It's it's it's definitely a blessing and I think we had to realize that as a defense, you know. >> Coming into your first Egg Bowl, what have you kind of learned about the rivalry so far and what makes this week so important? >> Man it's quite intense. It's quite intense man. I've I've I've been looking into it a little bit but yeah definitely just the the bad blood within the state man. I didn't think it was going to be you know this this this type of thing. I've I'm from the West Coast, you know California so I've never really heard of it until getting here and you know it's probably the biggest thing the state has to offer, you know. I'm I'm sure regardless of you know records for both teams, what it looks like, it's always you know one of them them games, you know what I mean? So I'm really excited to get there this next week and I think the rest of the team is too. >> And when you have guys like Will and Perk and Cam Franklin, all these Mississippi guys before that game, do they have anything to say about it or is it just kind of they let they let everyone else do the talking about it? >> Nah they definitely have something to say about it. I think those guys have all been here for what four years now, this is their fourth year so every single time they play them they know what it is and it's always you know a real good game so they're telling us, you know regardless what it looks like or what the team looks like records wise, it's it's one of them games and we got to bring it, you know what I mean? And it's going to be real fun, I think, and they're really excited to get, you know, going on this week. >> Pete also discussed being I guess more of a traditional head coach and not calling the the game this weekend. I I don't know if you had any personal meetings with him or not, but what have you seen from him through this week that may have differed from weeks in the past? >> I do have personal meets with him, you know, I I try to talk to him as much as I possibly can. He's just a very smart dude, very very smart dude, but uh like I kind of said earlier, he just kind of wants to get back to the identity of just playing hard, you know. It doesn't really matter, you know, if we um I wouldn't say it doesn't necessarily matter if we mess up. Everything, you know, matters, but if you mess up full speed, it's a lot better than messing up, you know, going half speed or, you know, looking and wishing you could have went harder on such and such play, you know. Just getting back to being ferocious and playing full speed and, you know, ending up where you end up and whether it's a full speed, you know, mistake or a full speed, you know, great play, you know what I mean? So I think that was kind of like the main focus this week. >> Any other questions? All right. Thanks, y'all. Appreciate it. >> Thanks for having me.
